output.title: Where-used report or Excel export times out or fails for widely used parts
output.applies_when: A user's where-used report or where-used export to Excel spins, times out, or fails, typically for common parts such as fasteners used in many assemblies or when the list is needed for an ECO.

steps.text: Confirm the symptom: the where-used report or export to Excel for the user's part number spins, times out, or fails. Record the part number.

quotes.quote: Exporting where-used for 210-007835 to Excel spins and fails.
Where-used report times out for fasteners used in many assemblies.
Need the where-used list for an ECO but the export fails.

steps.text: Run the where-used report for the user directly from the database and provide the results to the user.

quotes.quote: Ran the report for the user from the database.
Ran the report for the user from the database.

unknowns: Which database, query, or tool is used to run the where-used report, and who has access to run it (which support team or role).
The format in which results are delivered to the user (e.g. Excel file) and how they are sent.
How the user should request this (request form or ticket category) and whether any approval is needed.
Expected turnaround time; tickets currently take a median of 51.8 hours to resolve.
Whether the user can do anything themselves to avoid the timeout (e.g. filters, smaller scope, off-hours run); the tickets do not say.
The root cause of the timeout and whether a permanent fix (performance tuning, report change) is planned, and who owns that problem (PRB-12).
Who to contact or escalate to if running the report from the database also fails.
